en.Situation: In my first marketing role, a Meta campaign for a skincare client spent three thousand dollars with a click rate of 0.4 per cent.
en.Task: I had to find out why before asking for more budget, and report it to the brand manager honestly.
en.Action: I compared the ad sets by placement, found two thirds of the spend went to a placement with the worst rate, and shifted it to the two that worked.
en.Result: The click rate rose to 1.1 per cent in the next week without extra spend, and the brand manager approved a second month.
en.vague: The campaign was not doing well and we changed some things.
en.exaggerated: I tripled the brand's revenue in one week.
en.no_data: After the changes the campaign did better.

zh.Situation: 第一份 marketing 工作，一個護膚品牌嘅 Meta campaign 花了三千元，click rate 只有 0.4%。
zh.Task: 我要喺要求加預算之前找出原因，並老實向品牌主管報告。
zh.Action: 我按版位比較 ad set，發現三分二花費去咗表現最差嘅版位，於是轉去表現好嘅兩個。
zh.Result: 下星期 click rate 升到 1.1%，冇加預算，品牌主管批准做多一個月。
zh.vague: 個 campaign 表現麻麻，我哋改咗啲嘢。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個星期令品牌收入翻三倍。
zh.no_data: 改完之後 campaign 好啲。

en.Situation: Two years in, the Looker Studio dashboard showed ROAS dropping for a retail client, and the sales lead wanted to pause everything.
en.Task: I had to check whether the drop was real before anyone switched off a working campaign.
en.Action: I checked the tracking tag, found a duplicated purchase event inflating the old figures, and rebuilt the report without it.
en.Result: The corrected ROAS was still above target, and the campaign kept running through the sale period.
en.vague: ROAS looked like it dropped and we discussed pausing.
en.exaggerated: I saved the client a large amount of wasted spend.
en.no_data: After checking, the campaign carried on.

zh.Situation: 做咗兩年，Looker Studio dashboard 顯示一個零售客戶 ROAS 下跌，銷售 lead 想全部暫停。
zh.Task: 我要喺有人關掉仍然有效嘅 campaign 之前，確認跌幅係唔係真。
zh.Action: 我查 tracking tag，發現一個重複嘅 purchase event 令舊數字虛高，於是重做報表。
zh.Result: 修正後 ROAS 仍然高過目標，campaign 喺特賣期繼續跑。
zh.vague: ROAS 睇落跌咗，我哋討論要唔要暫停。
zh.exaggerated: 我幫客戶慳咗一大筆浪費嘅開支。
zh.no_data: 查完之後 campaign 繼續。

en.Situation: The KOL agency missed the content deadline twice for a launch, and our own designer had already built the landing page around their posts.
en.Task: I had to keep the launch date and keep the agency relationship, without pretending the delay was fine.
en.Action: I called the account manager, agreed two posts for the launch week and the rest a week later, and told our designer the new order.
en.Result: The launch went out on the original date, and the agency delivered the remaining posts with a written schedule.
en.vague: The agency was late with content.
en.exaggerated: I fixed the agency's whole delivery process.
en.no_data: In the end we launched on the original date.

zh.Situation: KOL agency 為一個發佈會兩次漏 deadline，而我哋設計師已經按佢哋嘅帖文做好 landing page。
zh.Task: 我要守住發佈日期，同時保住 agency 關係，但唔可以扮延誤冇問題。
zh.Action: 我打電話畀 account manager，議定發佈週先出兩則，其餘遲一星期，再通知設計師新次序。
zh.Result: 發佈會原定日期出街，agency 亦交咗書面時間表出餘下帖文。
zh.exaggerated: 我修好咗 agency 成個交付流程。
zh.no_data: 最後發佈會照原定日期出。

en.Situation: Four years in, an EDM to sixty thousand contacts had an open rate of eight per cent and the sales team said email was dead.
en.Task: I had to test one hypothesis at a time, and I had only two sends before the quarter ended.
en.Action: I split the list by last purchase recency, sent the same offer with two subject lines, and compared opens within each group.
en.Result: The recent-buyer group opened at twenty-two per cent, and we cut the send list to that group for the next quarter.
en.vague: Email performance was poor and people wanted to stop it.
en.exaggerated: I revived the company's entire email channel.
en.no_data: After the test we changed how we sent email.

zh.Situation: 做咗四年，一封寄畀六萬聯絡人嘅 EDM 開信率只有 8%，銷售團隊話 email 已經死。
zh.Task: 我要一次只測一個假設，而季尾前只有兩次發送機會。
zh.Action: 我按最近購買時間分組，用同一個優惠配兩個主題行，再喺每組內比較開信率。
zh.Result: 近期買家組開信率 22%，下一季我們把發送名單收窄到呢一組。
zh.exaggerated: 我令公司成個 email 渠道復活。
zh.no_data: 測完之後我哋改咗發送方式。

en.Situation: In my internship, a colleague wanted to boost a social post the same afternoon with a budget we had not received approval for.
en.Task: I had to slow it down without making her look careless in front of the team.
en.Action: I asked what the post was meant to achieve, then suggested waiting one day for the approval email.
en.Result: Approval came the next morning, and the boosted post hit its target cost per click in two days.
en.vague: There was a question about whether we could boost a post.
en.exaggerated: I prevented an unauthorised spend that would have caused trouble.
en.no_data: In the end we waited and boosted the post.

zh.Situation: 實習時有位同事想當日下午就 boost 一個帖文，用一筆未批嘅預算。
zh.Task: 我要拖住，但唔想令佢喺團隊面前似做錯事。
zh.Action: 我問清楚個帖文想達到咩，再建議等一日拿批核電郵。
zh.Result: 第二朝批核到，boost 嘅帖文兩日內達到目標 CPC。
zh.vague: 有人問可唔可以 boost 個帖。
zh.exaggerated: 我阻止咗一次會出事嘅未授權開支。

en.Situation: A seasonal promotion needed five social posts, and the product team kept changing the offer description three days before launch.
en.Task: I had to freeze one message so the design and copy could be finished.
en.Action: I wrote the offer in one sentence, sent it to product and design together, and asked for a yes or a change by noon.
en.Result: Everyone approved the sentence by noon, and the five posts shipped without a rewrite.
en.vague: The offer description kept changing before launch.
en.exaggerated: I ended all last-minute changes in the marketing team.
en.no_data: After the freeze the posts went out on time.

zh.Situation: 一個季節性推廣要五則社交帖文，而產品團隊喺上線前三日不停改優惠描述。
zh.Task: 我要凍結一個講法，令設計同文案做得完。
zh.Action: 我把優惠寫成一句，同時發畀產品同設計，要求中午前答 yes 或提出改動。
zh.Result: 中午前全部都同意嗰句，五則帖文冇重寫就出咗。
zh.vague: 上線前優惠描述不停改。
zh.exaggerated: 我終結咗 marketing 團隊所有臨尾改動。

en.Situation: Five years in, our agency's biggest client wanted a report on why their cost per acquisition rose while their own sales were flat.
en.Task: I had to give an answer that was useful even though part of the story was outside our channels.
en.Action: I split conversions by channel and device, showed the rise was concentrated on one device, and asked the client to check their checkout on it.
en.Result: Their checkout broke on that device, and after the fix their CPA returned to the earlier level.
en.vague: Their CPA went up and we looked into the channels.
en.exaggerated: I found the client's site was completely broken.
en.no_data: After the fix the CPA came back down.

zh.Situation: 做咗五年，agency 最大客戶想知點解 CPA 升但佢哋自己銷量冇升。
zh.Task: 我要畀一個有用嘅答案，即使部分原因喺我哋渠道以外。
zh.Action: 我按渠道同裝置拆分轉換，顯示升幅集中喺一個裝置，再請客戶檢查該裝置上嘅結帳流程。
zh.Result: 該裝置上結帳壞咗，修好之後 CPA 返到之前水平。
zh.exaggerated: 我發現客戶個網站完全壞咗。
zh.no_data: 修好之後 CPA 回落。

en.Situation: In my first job, the weekly campaign report had fourteen metrics and the brand manager only read the first line.
en.Task: I wanted a report that led with the one number that decided anything.
en.Action: I asked her which number would change her next action, then put that number, its change and one reason at the top.
en.Result: She started replying to the report with decisions, and two lower metrics were dropped entirely.
en.vague: The report had too many numbers in it.
en.exaggerated: I rebuilt the company's whole reporting standard.
en.no_data: After the change she replied to the reports.

zh.Situation: 第一份工，每週 campaign 報告有十四個指標，而品牌主管只睇第一行。
zh.Task: 我想報告以一個真正影響決定嘅數字為主。
zh.Action: 我問佢邊個數字會改變佢下一個行動，再把該數字、變化同一個原因放喺最上面。
zh.Result: 佢開始回覆報告並作出決定，兩個較低層指標整個刪走。
zh.exaggerated: 我重建咗公司成個報告標準。
zh.no_data: 改完之後佢會回覆報告。

en.Situation: Two brands in the same group wanted the same Instagram slot in the same week, and our small team could only produce one set of assets.
en.Task: I had to sequence them and keep both brand managers informed.
en.Action: I checked each brand's stock levels, found one could wait a week, and wrote a short note to both with the reason and the new dates.
en.Result: Both brands accepted the order, and neither lost their planned promotion window.
en.vague: Two brands wanted the same slot.
en.exaggerated: I resolved a conflict between two major brands.
en.no_data: In the end both brands posted in turn.

zh.Situation: 同一個集團兩個品牌同一星期想要同一個 Instagram 檔期，而我們細團隊只做得出一套素材。
zh.Task: 我要排先後，並令兩位品牌主管都知情。
zh.Action: 我查每個品牌嘅庫存，發現其中一個可以等一星期，於是寫短訊向兩邊講原因同新日期。
zh.Result: 兩個品牌都接受次序，亦冇人錯過原定推廣窗口。
zh.vague: 兩個品牌想要同一個檔期。
zh.exaggerated: 我解決咗兩個大品牌之間嘅衝突。

en.Situation: Six years in, a client wanted to double the budget on a campaign with a cost per acquisition already above their target.
en.Task: I had to give a recommendation they could act on, which meant saying no to the easy answer.
en.Action: I modelled the last four weeks at double budget, showed the CPA would rise further, and proposed a smaller test on a new audience instead.
en.Result: The client took the smaller test, and the new audience reached their target CPA within ten days.
en.vague: The client wanted to spend more on a campaign.
en.exaggerated: I stopped the client from wasting a large budget.
en.no_data: In the end they tried a different audience and it worked better.

zh.Situation: 做咗六年，客戶想在 CPA 已超出目標嘅 campaign 上加倍預算。
zh.Task: 我要畀一個佢可以行動嘅建議，即係要拒絕最容易嘅答案。
zh.Action: 我用過去四星期模擬加倍預算嘅效果，顯示 CPA 會再升，再建議改為喺新受眾做細規模測試。
zh.Result: 客戶採用細測試，新受眾十日內達到目標 CPA。
zh.vague: 客戶想喺一個 campaign 花更多錢。
zh.exaggerated: 我阻止客戶浪費一大筆預算。
zh.no_data: 最後佢哋試另一個受眾，效果好啲。

en.Situation: On a six-month contract, I was asked to write bilingual copy for a campaign and the Chinese and English versions had different offers.
en.Task: I had to catch the mismatch before publication, without holding up the schedule.
en.Action: I put both versions side by side, listed the two differences, and asked the product owner which offer was correct before rewriting.
en.Result: One version had an old discount, and both were corrected the same afternoon.
en.vague: The two language versions were not the same.
en.exaggerated: I prevented a serious legal problem for the client.
en.no_data: In the end both versions were corrected.

zh.Situation: 做半年合約時，我要為一個 campaign 寫中英雙語文案，而兩個版本優惠唔同。
zh.Task: 我要喺發佈前發現落差，但唔可以拖住時間表。
zh.Action: 我把兩版並排，列出兩處差異，再問產品負責人邊個優惠才對，然後重寫。
zh.Result: 其中一版用咗舊折扣，兩版同一日下午改正。
zh.exaggerated: 我幫客戶避免咗一個嚴重法律問題。

en.Situation: A launch video was due Friday and the designer was on leave from Wednesday with the file half finished.
en.Task: I had to get it finished without asking her to work on leave.
en.Action: I asked her for a five-minute handover on Tuesday, found the remaining work was two captions, and did them from the brand guide myself.
en.Result: The video shipped Friday on brand, and the handover note was added to our launch checklist.
en.vague: The video was nearly finished when the designer went on leave.
en.exaggerated: I produced the whole launch video by myself.
en.no_data: In the end the video went out on Friday.

zh.Situation: 一段發佈影片星期五要交，而設計師星期三開始放假，個檔做咗一半。
zh.Task: 我要令佢完成，但唔可以叫佢放假期間做嘢。
zh.Action: 我星期二請佢用五分鐘交低，發現只剩兩個字幕，於是按品牌指引自己做。
zh.Result: 影片星期五準時出而且合乎品牌，交低嘅備註亦加入咗我哋發佈 checklist。
zh.vague: 設計師放假嗰時影片差唔多完成。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人做咗成段發佈影片。
